## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `co-change-precedent-projection`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-08T04:50:57.291Z.

Algorithm (12) co-change coupling mining + outcome-conditioned precedent projection (episodic future thinking; serves pm-vvib candidate 13). Two composable parts. Part A — evolutionary coupling from episodic streams: mine 'items/files that change together' association statistics directly from the immutable history (mining-software-repositories co-change coupling): for item pairs (i,j), maintain support = |sessions touching both| and confidence(i→j) = support / |sessions touching i|, where a 'session' is a same-author time-windowed burst of mutations (or an explicit focus session). Computed as a WRITE-TIME FOLD (algorithm 6) into a count-min-sketch-backed pair table (algorithm 8) so cost is O(burst width) per mutation and storage stays sublinear at millions of items; decay counts with ACT-R log-time activation (algorithm 1) so decades-old coupling fades without a cliff. This yields the tracker's latent 'hidden dependency' graph — edges nobody declared but history proves, exactly the edges that predict surprise breakage. Part B — outcome-conditioned precedent projection: given a target item (about to be claimed / planned), retrieve top-k precedents by WL structural fingerprint (algorithm 10) UNIONED with top-k by co-change neighborhood overlap from Part A, then score each precedent by outcome relevance: divergence signals from its close record (expected_result vs actual_result mismatch, reopen events, close_reason class, time-to-close vs estimate from pm-3hps calibration data). Emit (a) predicted blast radius = co-change neighbors above a confidence floor that are NOT in the declared dep/parent/file neighborhood (candidate advisory edges, feeding the pm-4ri6 dedupe/advisory surface), and (b) top failure precedents with one-line 'how it actually ended' summaries for the pm context / pm plan pre-mortem block. Both parts are recall-stage sources for the two-stage funnel (algorithm 7, new quota source) and their contributions stay linear/explainable in the scorer (algorithm 3). Spectrum-invariant: sketch + log decay for the millions-of-items end (pm-g2zz), degenerates gracefully to exact small tables under the pm-z436 small-end profile.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
